tail:
**Batch 71 authoring is complete.** The A/B pages and five draft items are in place; the local measure-isometry lemma supplies the weighted-space interface required by the design.

All five items have current Step 1 `ready` records at levels **0, 1, 2, 2, 3**. These record authoring readiness, not independent proof approval.

The final scoped checks passed: proof layout (27 steps, 0 defects), precheck, rendering, strict proof contracts, coverage, content policy, and dependency, forward-reference, and extcheck. Sources were fetch-verified 3/3, with no retrieval drops.

The plan and design agree on the assigned pages and requirements. The Berry flux and Chern number are both stated with their conventions. Full-text source locators and dispositions are in [coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-71.coverage.json>); they include [Tong](https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/qft/qfthtml/S6.html), [Palmerduca and Qin](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2308.11147), and [Bliokh et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1006.3876).

Artifacts: [A page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/quantum-field-theory-mathematics/qftx-photon-helicity.md>), [B page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/quantum-field-theory-mathematics/qftx-photon-helicity-examples.md>), [manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-71.pages.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-71.proof-contracts.json>), [cross-batch dependencies](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-71.cross-batch-dependencies.json>), and [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-71.notes.md>).

The **run-wide** batch dependency snapshot is stale, and the full item-level check encounters empty inventories in other batches. Batch 71’s scoped dependency graph passes; I left the shared scheduling file and other batches untouched for the owner’s drained join.
